# CLI: DNS

## get-hosted-zone

Kind: Read.

| Flag               | Type     | Required |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--hosted-zone-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode dns get-hosted-zone --hosted-zone-id <hosted-zone-id> --query HostedZone
```

## get-record

Kind: Read.

| Flag               | Type     | Required |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--hosted-zone-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--record-id`      | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode dns get-record --hosted-zone-id <hosted-zone-id> \
```

## list-hosted-zones

Kind: Read.

Reads one page. `--page` defaults to 1 and `--size` defaults to 10000.

| Flag     | Type     | Required |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--name` | `string` |          |
| `--page` | `int`    |          |
| `--size` | `int`    |          |

```sh
greennode dns list-hosted-zones
```

## list-records

Kind: Read.

Returns page metadata. If the service reports additional pages or rows, the
command exits 1 with `RequestFailed` and no stdout. Record continuation
parameters remain unverified.

| Flag               | Type     | Required |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--hosted-zone-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--name`           | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode dns list-records --hosted-zone-id <hosted-zone-id>
```
